newsitem.title: THAILAND: Three people drown in Thai boat accident.
newsitem.headline: Three people drown in Thai boat accident.

text.p: Three people, one an American, drowned after their overloaded boat capsized on a reservoir in western Thailand, police said on Sunday.
One man survived and another was still missing, police told Reuters.
Arthur Lee Porter, a 35-year-old jazz pianist from the United States, was one of the victims, police said.
The five people were crossing an agricultural reservoir in Kanchanaburi province, 130 km west of Bangkok, late on Saturday.
The identities of the Thai man and woman who also died were not released.
No other details were available on Sunday.
